prompt: The man stays on the spot at the same size and angle, the camera almost motionless. His wide grin holds for a beat too long while his eyes stay on the people just beside the camera, and the smile slowly stiffens and sets, cheeks rigid, his hands settling still in front of him. Then he recovers and He says: I've got a good feeling. He gives one small, confident nod as he finishes, the grin back in place. The staircase and brick wall behind him do not move. Sound: a moment of near silence in the room, then his upbeat male voice, close, over the quiet room tone of a big brick loft.
